opcode.name: VOICE_TX_PACKET
opcode.comments: The voice task sends the Tx packet every frame.

opcode.name: VOICE_DRIFT_REPORT
opcode.comments: The voice task will send this message only if configured by bit 3 of the VoiceTestWord (Start Voice Path or Voice Test control).

opcode.name: End_CONV_ACK
opcode.comments: The voice command handler will send this message after having freed all its resources (OS and GPM resources).

opcode.name: PCM Stream Record
opcode.comments: Pointer to a ready record buffer on CPU memory

opcode.name: GET_PCM_FRAME
opcode.comments: Pointer to required next frame buffer (CPU should copy upon message the next PCM buffer to be played)

opcode.name: VOICE_DEBUG_RX_PACKET
opcode.comments: The voice task receives an Rx packet every frame. It takes the vocoder packet and add it the vocoder type as the first data. This is only a debug feature.

opcode.name: VOICE_MODULE_DEBUG_REPORT
opcode.comments: When set, Send the status of the voice control word and energy calculations for both paths.

opcode.name: VOICE_PCM_VIA_IPC
opcode.comments: The voice command handler will send this message containing rx before or after, tx before or after and one frame of reference mic signal via IPC.
